title: Ntorq 125 Race Edition Yellow (Track Edition)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the TVS Motor Company Ntorq 125 Race Edition Yellow (Track Edition) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. At its heart lies a 125cc powertrain delivering 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 108 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
